title: Admissible fields on an open U ⊆ ℝ^N define a locally bounded linear functional on C_c(U; ℝ^N)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N open (carrying the subspace topology), and Λ : (ℝ^N → ℝ^N) → ℝ. Call g : ℝ^N → ℝ^N admissible if g is continuous with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ U. Assume Λ(g + h) = Λ(g) + Λ(h) and Λ(c g) = c Λ(g) for all admissible g, h and c ∈ ℝ. Assume also that for every compact K ⊆ U there is C ∈ ℝ with Λ(g) ≤ C for every continuous g with tsupport g ⊆ K and |g(x)| ≤ 1 for all x. Then there is an ℝ-linear map L : C_c(U; ℝ^N) → ℝ with two properties. (i) For every compact K ⊆ U (compact in the subspace U) there is C ∈ ℝ with L(f) ≤ C for every f ∈ C_c(U; ℝ^N) with |f(y)| ≤ 1 for all y ∈ U and tsupport f ⊆ K. (ii) For every admissible g there is f ∈ C_c(U; ℝ^N) with f(y) = g(y) for all y ∈ U and L(f) = Λ(g).
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (Λ : (Rn N → Rn N) → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ g h : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → tsupport h ⊆ U → Λ (g + h) = Λ g + Λ h) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (g : Rn N → Rn N), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Λ (c • g) = c * Λ g) → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → tsupport g ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → Λ g ≤ C) → ∃ L : C_c(U, Rn N) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ K : Set U, IsCompact K → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f : C_c(U, Rn N), (∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) → tsupport f ⊆ K → L f ≤ C) ∧ ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → ∃ f : C_c(U, Rn N), (∀ y : U, f y = g ↑y) ∧ L f = Λ g
